description: Base libraries for Git as the Persistence of Versioned Documents: a server-side Git repository, reached through JGit in memory without working trees, as the persistence of an application in which users maintain versioned documents. A multi-module Maven reactor whose modules are released together and consumed separately.
description_reasoning: source: README.adoc 'What is it?' section and AGENTS.md Project section

documentation.description: AsciiDoc documentation of the libraries: concepts, ADRs and per-module specifications (requirements prefix GDR), plus the self-contained CISOs-Friend application docs (prefix CIFR) in doc/app.

git-core.description: Foundation library on JGit: hardened repositories, remote policy, commit and reference identity, results, transport, reading, cache repository, in-core writing, compare-and-swap, in-core merge and notes. Currently a scaffold (module-info and @NullMarked package only).

git-document-repository.description: Root Maven reactor POM (parent de.cuioss:cui-java-parent) that aggregates and versions git-core, git-worktrees and git-testing so they are released together.

git-testing.description: Test-support library with generators and fixtures for local and in-memory Git repositories and a local remote, consumed by the other modules' tests. Currently a scaffold.

git-worktrees.description: Library for linked working trees on top of git-core: commit from a working tree and working-tree status. Currently a scaffold.

name: git-document-repository
